All rights reserved Powered by Happydance Aristocrat Careers Saved Jobs Technical Support Specialist Location Links : Las Vegas Employment Type : Full time - Work Pattern : Onsite - Contract Type : Permanent Check job match Check culture match The Role As a Technical Support Specialist I, you will play a pivotal role in our team, delivering flawless support and outstanding service to our customers. This opportunity is unique as it allows you to work with powerful technology in a dynamic and encouraging environment. Join us and contribute to our proven track record of success while advancing your career in an exciting and encouraging company! What You'll Do Offer direct troubleshooting and assistance for gaming cabinets, computers, and related hardware. Identify and fix hardware, software, power, connectivity, and configuration problems. Install, configure, repair, and validate technical equipment in various customer environments. Apply remote-support tools to assist in resolving technical issues. Interpret technical documentation and collect diagnostic evidence for accurate service activity documentation. Deliver outstanding customer service by maintaining composure during high-impact situations. Prioritize field requests and bring up complex issues appropriately. Travel to customer sites for hands-on support and participate in after-hours or on-call coverage as needed. What We're Looking For 4+ years of relevant experience in supporting gaming equipment, electromechanical products, or complex technology. Strong competence with gaming cabinets, electronic components, and related hardware. Demonstrated skill in methodically identifying and fixing technical problems. Experience with computer operating systems, networking fundamentals, and remote-support tools. Excellent communication and customer-service skills. Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks efficiently. Willingness to travel and provide on-site support. Familiarity with regulated gaming environments and gaming cabinet architecture is a plus. Experience with AI-enabled applications, data analysis tools, and case-management platforms is beneficial. Technical certifications or related education in IT, electronics, or engineering technology is preferred. All rights reserved Powered by Happydance Aristocrat Careers Saved Jobs QA Engineer Location Links : Sofia Employment Type : Full time - Work Pattern : Hybrid - Contract Type : Permanent Check job match Check culture match The Role The QA Engineer role is a critical part of the software delivery lifecycle, responsible for ensuring product quality, validating new functionality, performing test plans, identifying and documenting defects, supporting defect resolution, and enabling successful releases across multiple initiatives. The role also contributes to continuous quality improvement and provides crucial feedback to development and product teams. What You'll Do Develop and complete test plans and test scripts for new and existing game themes and operating systems. Submit and track any product issues found during testing to ensure they are resolved. Provide input to the project status report for each assigned project. Reproduce issues as necessary to assist software development in resolving them. Provide feedback for continuous test improvement. Detect, separate, and record bugs clearly and concisely in a bug tracker in English. Maintain open communication with your immediate manager and ensure that performance standards and expectations are met. Regularly update and discuss ongoing tasks and projects with your direct manager. Provide timely progress reports and seek mentorship as needed to ensure efficient workflow. Attend and contribute to team huddles, meetings, and ad hoc meetings as required. Support additional tasks and projects as designated by supervisors or management to advance department and organizational objectives. What We're Looking For Proven experience in QA engineering or software testing. Outstanding attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Solid knowledge of designing test plans and test scripts. Ability to detect, separate, and record bugs effectively. Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Experience with bug tracking tools and software development collaboration. Ability to sustain open communication and deliver timely progress updates. Strong capability to work closely with all relevant parties, both inside and outside the company. Ambitious approach with a dedication to continuous improvement and flawless execution. Ability to work under strict deadlines and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. All rights reserved Powered by Happydance Aristocrat Careers Saved Jobs Game Operations Specialist Location Links : Sofia Employment Type : Full time - Work Pattern : Hybrid - Contract Type : Permanent Check job match Check culture match The Role At Aristocrat, we are committed to crafting top-tier gaming experiences that spread happiness to millions worldwide. As a Game Operations Specialist, you will have a meaningful role ensuring game content is delivered flawlessly, punctually, and meets our high standards. You will become part of a dynamic team that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence. What You'll Do Plan, schedule, coordinate, and complete game releases and content updates across multiple environments. Manage and maintain game configurations, including metadata, feature settings, stakes, and environment-specific parameters. Support business-as-usual operations by coordinating routine updates, patches, and hotfixes with minimal disruption to live environments. Coordinate the onboarding of new markets and operator integrations, ensuring operational readiness, structured testing, and smooth debut execution. Provide operational and technical support during onboarding and post-launch activities, working with internal teams to resolve configuration and integration issues. Coordinate the scheduling, validation, and deployment of third-party and in-house content following release plans and market demands. Monitor live operational processes and find opportunities to improve workflows, efficiency, and release quality. What We're Looking For 2+ years of experience in game operations, content distribution, release coordination, or a similar technical or operational role. Experience working with external partners, operators, or third-party vendors is considered an advantage. Familiarity with iGaming or digital content ecosystems is preferred. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple teams and collaborators. High attention to detail and a proactive, practical approach to problem-solving. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver with a high level of accuracy and accountability. Familiarity with release processes, build and release tools, Excel, and other operational systems is beneficial. Flexibility to support release windows and operational blocking issues when required. Join us at Aristocrat to be part of an ambitious team where your skills and passion for gaming can make a real impact. Apply today and help us continue to deliver outstanding experiences to players worldwide! Overview Community Careers Our Core Values THE ARISTOCRAT STORY Our purpose is to create the world’s greatest gaming experience, every day. Aristocrat Leisure Limited is an ASX100 listed company and one of the world’s leading providers of gaming solutions. We’re licensed in 240 gaming jurisdictions and operate in 90 countries around the world, with a team of over 3000 employees who deliver outstanding results by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity and technology. Since our humble beginnings in 1953, we’ve been driven by a desire to create the world’s greatest gaming experience, every day. We offer a diverse range of products and services, including electronic gaming machines, social gaming and casino management systems. But despite our global presence and exponential growth, we remain an ideas company at heart, committed to entertaining the world one game at a time. THE FUTURE OF GAMING We’re pioneers in our field and relentless in our pursuit of excellence. Aristocrat is an ideas company at heart, which means innovation is embedded into every aspect of our business. Whether we’re designing sleek new cabinets, premium game content or award-winning systems, we apply fresh thinking and creativity to deliver the world’s greatest gaming experience, every day. INFINITE CREATIVITY Our creative studios are the best in the business. We believe creative excellence starts with our people and ends with our product. In between, there’s a whole lot of dreaming, collaborating and designing that challenges industry norms, solves business problems and creates thrilling entertainment for players around the world. Show more BUILDING BETTER COMMUNITIES We believe in giving back to the communities where we live and work, by supporting charities that reflect the values of Aristocrat and our 3000 people around the world. Every employee is encouraged to participate in fundraising activities for their local region, with one day of paid leave available each year so they can volunteer and support the charity of their choice. Our annual ‘Global Volunteer Week’ unites employees in an inspiring demonstration of our values, with teams volunteering their time, energy and skills to make a real difference in their local community. In addition to a global workplace giving program, we also support a number of regional fundraising and volunteer initiatives, including the ‘Building Hope’ program in the United States and the ‘Giving Ways’ program in Australia and New Zealand. Giving back not only helps us build better communities, it sparks passion and purpose in our employees. We see it every time they feed the homeless, work at an animal shelter or volunteer their time for one of our charity partners. Our commitment to being a socially responsible, ethical and sustainable business is also reflected in our environmental initiatives. These include energy efficiency and recycling programs, proactive strategies to save energy and water, stringent environmental controls in manufacturing and maintaining fuel-efficiency in our vehicles. COMMITTED TO RESPONSIBLE GAMING As one of the world’s largest gaming companies, Aristocrat is proud to lead by example and maintain a strong commitment to responsible gaming in the community and online. This is consistent with our vision for a gaming and hospitality sect
